Hello,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the duplicate charges for your in-app subscription.

I looked up your account (`cust-88`) in our direct billing system, but there are no direct invoices or payment records listed under your account. 

### Why this happens
Subscriptions purchased directly inside mobile applications are processed and billed by the respective app store platform (**Apple App Store** or **Google Play Store**) rather than our direct web billing system. Because of this, third-party app store charges do not appear in our internal invoicing system, and we are unable to issue a direct refund on our end.

### How to request a refund for the duplicate charge

* **Apple App Store (iOS):**
  1. Go to [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com) and sign in with your Apple ID.
  2. Select **"Request a refund"** from the drop-down menu.
  3. Choose the reason (e.g., duplicate purchase) and select the duplicate charge to submit your request.

* **Google Play Store (Android):**
  1. Go to [play.google.com/store/account/order-history](https://play.google.com/store/account/order-history).
  2. Find the duplicate subscription charge.
  3. Select **"Report a problem"** or **"Request a refund"** and complete the form.

If you believe this charge was made directly through our website using a different email address or customer ID, please provide any receipt numbers or the email address associated with that purchase so I can investigate further!

If the issue persists after attempting these steps, please let us know so we can assist you further!
